app.name: Sazkara Maintenance
app.brandBlurb: Repairs reported from the shop floor, live project progress and a standard JTI export — instead of the paper form and manual Excel entry.

auth.loginSubtitle: Use your mobile number and password
auth.registerSubtitle: Your account must be approved by the repair manager before you can sign in
auth.name: Full name
auth.pendingBody: The repair manager needs to approve your account. You can sign in once that happens.
auth.rejectedBody: Your account was not approved. Please contact the repair manager.

errors.pending: Your account has not been approved yet
errors.phoneTaken: That mobile number is already registered
errors.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters
errors.invalidPhone: That mobile number is not valid

technician.enterUidHelp: The UID is printed on the stand
technician.notFoundInOrder: This UID is not in the current order
technician.notFoundHelp: You can still continue — it will be recorded as out-of-order and sent to the manager for confirmation.
technician.noHistory: No previous reports for this UID
technician.reRepairWarning: This stand was already repaired in this project, so this report is recorded as a re-repair.
technician.previousProjectNotice: This stand was repaired in an earlier project. This report is not a re-repair and goes in the main export.

form.title: Stand repair form
form.digitalAddressHelp: Google Maps link for the store
form.locationDenied: Location access was denied — enter the link manually.
form.outcomeAuto: The outcome is derived from the parts recorded: if at least one part is replaced or repaired, the visit counts as repaired.
form.replacedHelp: Only replaced parts count toward inventory and billing.
form.repairedHelp: Parts fixed in place, which consume no inventory.
form.tapToSelect: Tap a part to select it
form.photosHelp: Three photos are required: the store, and the stand before and after.
form.signatureHelp: Sign in the box with your finger or mouse

errors.reasonRequired: Pick a reason when no parts were recorded
errors.partsOrReason: Either record parts, or pick a reason the stand was not repaired
errors.invalidQuantity: One of the part quantities is not valid.
errors.extraUidRequired: Enter the UID for stand {n, number}.

form.extraStandHelp: If this store has more than one stand, enter each UID and its repair details separately here.
form.sharedUidNote: Stand {n, number} at the same UID ({uid}) — it has no separate UID.
form.standPhotosHelp: Before and after photos of THIS stand

reasons.MANAGER_NOT_AUTHORIZED: Store manager did not authorize the repair
reasons.STORE_OR_STAND_REMOVED: Store or stand was removed / collected
reasons.ALREADY_HEALTHY: Stand was already healthy, no repair needed
reasons.CONDITION_TOO_POOR: Stand's condition was too poor to repair

dashboard.title: Repair manager dashboard
dashboard.wageSplitHelp: Technician pay is calculated separately for Tehran and for all other cities.
dashboard.subStandsHelp: Second and later stand at the same store
dashboard.isTehran: Apply the Tehran wage rate to this city

imports.title: Jti orders
imports.uploadHelp: Pick the Excel file Jti sent (xlsx or xls).
imports.mappingHelp: Match each column in the file to a system field. Only the UID is required.
imports.profileMatched: Profile "{name}" matches this file's layout and has been applied.
imports.saveProfile: Save this mapping for next time
imports.duplicatesHelp: These UIDs have been repaired before. Decide which ones enter the order — nothing is dropped or included without your decision.
imports.invalidRows: {count, number} rows without a UID will be skipped
imports.duplicateInFile: {count, number} UIDs repeated inside the file
imports.manualUidHelp: UIDs Jti sent as plain text rather than in the spreadsheet.
imports.manualUidPlaceholder: Separate UIDs with spaces, commas or new lines

errors.uidRequired: The Stand UID column must be mapped
errors.noRows: No rows found in this sheet

imports.deleteOrderConfirm: Delete this order and all of its rows? Submitted repair reports are kept.
imports.cannotDeleteWithForms: This order has repair reports against it and cannot be deleted.
imports.deleteOrderWithFormsConfirm:
Delete order "{name}"?

{forms} repair reports have been filed against this order’s UIDs. Those reports are NOT deleted — they stay in the UID history, the exports and the statistics; only the order itself goes.

Continue?
imports.orderDeletedKeptForms: Order "{name}" was deleted. {forms} repair reports were kept.
imports.targetOrderHelp: Append the UID to an existing order, or start a new one inside a project.
imports.deleteOrderAndFormsConfirm:
Delete order "{name}" AND its {forms} repair reports?

Their photos, signatures and parts usage are erased too, and they disappear from the dashboard and every export.

This cannot be undone. Continue?
imports.orderDeletedRemovedForms: Order "{name}" and its {forms} reports were deleted.

pendingUids.title: UIDs awaiting confirmation
pendingUids.help: UIDs a technician or manager added outside the official order. They stay out of official stats until you confirm them.

technicians.title: Technicians
technicians.approveConfirm: Approve {name}? A technician code will be assigned.

exports.title: Exports
exports.jtiHelp: The 43-column file with Jti's original headers. Only repaired stands in the selected range are included.
exports.includeReRepairsHelp: A re-repair is not counted again in the repaired-stand statistic, but its parts were genuinely consumed and normally belong in Jti's file.
exports.partsHelp: Total replaced parts across every city, broken down per part. Parts repaired in place are excluded.
exports.noRows: There is nothing to export in this range
exports.contentScopeHelp: A re-repair is the same UID twice within one project. UIDs repaired in earlier projects stay in the main file and are only tinted.

evidence.title: Evidence PDFs
evidence.help: One PDF per day per city: a cover page plus one page for each stand visited.
evidence.noVisits: No visits recorded for that day and city

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.successRateHelp: Share of visited stands that were repaired.
analytics.partsRateHelp: For example "53% of stands needed a transformer replaced".
analytics.forecastHelp: Estimate parts needed for the next phase from historical consumption.

uidSearch.title: UID search
uidSearch.notFound: No stand found with that UID
uidSearch.formDeleted: Report {code} was deleted. This UID is back on the outstanding list.

formView.title: Form {code}
formView.wageTierFirst: First stand at this store today
formView.wageTierSecond: Second stand at the same store
formView.wageTierThird: Third or later stand at the same store
formView.deleteConfirm: Delete this report? Its photos and signatures go too, and the UID returns to the work queue.
formView.editHelp: Changing the parts re-derives the repair outcome and the wage.
formView.cannotEditPhotos: Photos and signatures cannot be edited; delete the report so it can be filed again.

reRepairs.title: Re-repairs
reRepairs.help: Stands repaired twice within one project. The same UID recurring in a later project is not a re-repair. These are not counted again in "stands repaired", but the parts they consumed still count toward usage totals.
reRepairs.daysAfter: {days, number} days after the previous repair
reRepairs.quickHelp: Within 14 days of the previous repair
reRepairs.exportHelp: Excel and evidence PDFs for re-repairs, separate from the main repairs
reRepairs.previousProjectHelp: This UID was repaired in a different project; it does not count as a re-repair of this one.

settings.title: Settings
settings.wagesHelp: The first stand at a store earns the city rate; further stands at the same store on the same day earn the reduced rate.
settings.secondStandRate: Second stand at the same store
settings.thirdPlusStandRate: Third and later stands at the same store
settings.managerContactEmailHelp: Printed on the evidence PDF cover page.
settings.citiesHelp: Tehran is flagged separately so the wage split can track it on its own.
settings.unrepairedVisitRateHelp: Paid for any visit that produced no repair (store closed, permission refused, ...). If the same stand is repaired on a later visit, that visit is priced at the normal rate.
settings.mergeHelp: If one city was recorded twice (say "Tehran" and "تهران"), this moves all of its stores, reports and evidence onto the surviving city and deletes the duplicate.
settings.mergeConfirm: Merge "{source}" into "{target}"? {count} records move across and the source city is deleted.
settings.duplicateCitiesHelp: These look like the same city. Until they are merged, statistics and the wage split are divided between them.
settings.logoHelp: Printed on the evidence PDF cover. PNG or JPG, up to 4 MB.

parts.title: Part catalogue
parts.help: These 30 parts form columns 5–34 of the Jti export and their order is fixed.

historical.title: Historical data import
historical.help: Import completed reports from an Excel file
historical.expectedFormat: For pre-system archives and for paper reports typed up mid-project alike. Both the legacy and current spreadsheet formats are supported.
historical.willCreate: {forms} reports across {uids} distinct UIDs ({newUids} new to the system).
historical.formatHelp: Both formats stay available. If auto-detection gets it wrong, state the format yourself.

AUTO.title: Detect automatically
AUTO.help: Work the format out from the headers.

LEGACY.title: Legacy format (pre-system)
LEGACY.help: 28 part columns, two-row header, feedback in column AP.

CURRENT.title: Current format (app export)
CURRENT.help: 30 part columns, exactly what this app produces.

historical.repeatedUids: {count} UID(s) appear on more than one row. Each row still becomes its own report; only one order line is created per UID.
historical.columnMismatchHelp: Quantities are read by column position. If these columns are a different part, the parts usage will be recorded against the wrong entries. Check before committing.
historical.deleteImportConfirm: Delete every report from this import? This is for undoing a partial or wrong upload and cannot be reversed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.duplicateUid: That UID is already in this order.
errors.lineHasForms: A repair report exists for this UID, so the row cannot be deleted.
errors.cannotDeleteWithForms: This order has repair reports against it and cannot be deleted.
errors.phaseMismatch: The selected phase does not belong to this project.
errors.qualityOutOfRange: Quality score must be between 0 and 5.
errors.sameCity: The source and target city cannot be the same.
errors.cityInUse: That city is in use; merge it instead of deleting it.
errors.selfLead: A technician cannot be their own lead.
errors.notALead: The selected user is not a crew lead.
errors.projectNotEmpty: That project is not empty; deleting it needs a second confirmation.
errors.invalidImage: Only PNG, JPG or WebP is accepted.

projects.title: Projects and phases
projects.description: A project is one Jti campaign. The project boundary is what defines a re-repair.
projects.name: Project name
projects.deleteFullConfirm:
Project "{name}" has {forms} reports and {batches} orders.

The reports are NOT deleted — they are detached from this project and left without one.

Continue?

uidArchive.title: UID archive
uidArchive.help: One row per UID, summarising every report filed against it within the current filter.

workExport.title: Work export
workExport.help: Your submitted reports for a period or a project, as a spreadsheet.

lead.title: Crew lead dashboard
lead.crewHelp: Technicians reporting to you. Assignment is done by the manager.
lead.noCrew: No technicians assigned to you yet.
lead.scopeNote: This page shows your crew’s work only; wages, the Jti export and settings stay with the manager.
